newsitem.title: UK: Standard Life reports jump in IFA sales.
newsitem.headline: Standard Life reports jump in IFA sales.

text.p: British mutual insurer Standard Life said on Wednesday that independent financial advice (IFA) sales of life and pension policies rose sharply in the half year to May.
Regular premium business increased 46 percent over the period, while individual pension business was up 65 percent.
Effective income - annual premium and 10 percent of premium income - rose 25 percent over last year's figures.
IFA sales accounts for over 85 percent of Standard Life's business.
"IFAs are recognising our efforts to improve our service and to market products that meet the needs of our customers," said Standard Life's assistant general sales manager Norman Arthur.
